title: Equipment Datasheet - SEPARATOR LEVEL CONTROL VALVE (LV-6701)
content:
EQUIPMENT DATASHEET: LV-6701 (SEPARATOR LEVEL CONTROL VALVE).
Document No: TJC-LLD-DS-LV-6701, Revision: Rev 3, Status: Issued for Operation.
Equipment Type: Globe Control Valve + Diaphragm Actuator.
Plant Unit: Linear Low Density Polyethylene (LLDPE) Unit, Area: 6700 – Product Separation.
Functional Location: TJC-LLD-6700-01, Criticality: Low Critical.
Service: Level control of LP Separator FA-6710 bottoms to downstream.
MECHANICAL SPECIFICATIONS:
Valve Type: GLOBE, CAGE-GUIDED, ED; Fail Action: FAIL CLOSED (FC); Actuator: FISHER 667 SIZE 45; Body Size: 3 inch (DN80); Positioner: DVC6200 HART, 4-20 mA; Body Rating: ASME 300#; Air Supply: 1.4 barg INSTRUMENT AIR; Body Material: WCC CARBON STEEL; Packing: PTFE V-RING; Trim Material: SS316 + STELLITE; Bench Set: 0.2-1.0 barg; Trim Characteristic: EQUAL PERCENTAGE; Handwheel: TOP-MOUNTED; Rated CV: 110; Service Fluid: HEXANE + POLYMER BOTTOMS
MOTOR & ELECTRICAL SPECIFICATIONS:
Controller: LIC-6701 (on FA-6710 level); Action on Air Fail: VALVE CLOSES; Input Signal: 4-20 mA; Solenoid: XV-6701 (ESD); Stroke: 38 mm; Limit Switch: ZSL/ZSH-6701; Leakage Class: ANSI CLASS IV; Driver Type: Pneumatic Spring-Diaphragm Actuator
CROSS REFERENCES: P&ID: TJC-LLD-PID-6701, Interlock: SEQ-6701.
